title: Nexus and Prime Relays
subtitle: The ending state should be visible
summary: Late-game relay scans, boss intel, Nexus UI, branch choice, and ending presentation must explain what is at stake and what changes next.
body: Prime relay pages should show scan status, branch pressure, route risk, and the next required objective.
Boss intel should name the countermeasure and reward before the arena turns into a commitment point.
Ending branches should clearly present Restore, Destroy, and Control consequences in Terminal, Codex/Index, and HoloMap state.
